title: When the Asset Sings
author: Kestrel Halloran
blurb: Marguerite Delacroix, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
